# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 94 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 94 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_094_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 11

**1** "First learn who I am," he said to me. "Lord, instruct me," I replied. "Who do you suppose the tall man is — the one who bears the name of the Son of God?" he asked. **2** "I replied, "The Son of God is the man clothed in the Holy Spirit of God." "You have spoken rightly," he said; "for the Son of God is indeed the one clothed in the Holy Spirit, **3** and through him the whole world was created and sustained. And note this: he is more ancient than all creation, and through him God laid the foundations of all things. He himself is the foundation and the cornerstone." **4** "But why," I asked, "does he sometimes appear as aged and sometimes as young?" "Because he appeared as ancient," he answered, "the Son of God is pre-existent and appeared to his servants at both the beginning and the end; he appeared as ancient to those of the former covenant, and to those of the new covenant he appeared as young and new. **5** For what you see is the new age — he renews all things and makes them new. **6** The old things have been accomplished and have passed away. And he appointed twelve people and gave them authority to walk in his commandments. After these he appointed twelve more, and then seven. All of these walked in the power of the Son of God."

---

*LOGOS: "foundation and cornerstone" renders both themelios and akrogōniaion — cornerstone christology echoing Ps 118:22, Isa 28:16, Eph 2:20.*
